Maintained by vidore, this model enables efficient document indexing and retrieval from visual features using a novel omnimodal architecture. sources.title: colqwen-omni-v0.1 by vidore | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: Overview ColQwen Omni extends the ColPali paradigm to all modalities (documents, audio, and video) using ColBERT-style multi-vector representations built on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B. Unlike dense single-vector models, multi-vector retrieval preserves fine-grained token-level matching, delivering higher precision on complex queries.

sources.title: colqwen-omni-v0.1 · Models - modelscope.cn
sources.snippet: ColQwen-Omni is a model based on a novel model architecture and training strategy based on Omnimodal Language Models to efficiently index documents from their visual features. It is a Qwen2.5-Omni-3B extension that generates ColBERT - style multi-vector representations of text and images.
